What is conversation-steganography?

Use LLMs to hide messages inside normal looking conversations

Evidence: github.com

Who should consider it?

This guide is most relevant to backend developers evaluating tools in the Go ecosystem. The source associates the project with llm tools, steganography. Treat it as a starting point for a shortlist, then compare the official documentation with your own requirements.
